name: two_episode_full_chord_curriculum_20261025
comparison: Four fresh longer-training runs following the frozen eight-run pilot; not a new correction ablation.
recipe: Our SAC plus world model and soft corrected references, with frozen SONIC, CHORD's 350M-transition assistance curriculum and raw residual bound 10.
initialization: Independent from scratch per episode and tier; assistance is an explicit policy/critic/model input. No Tier 1 transfer to Tier 2.
evaluation: Unassisted full-episode rollout every 35M transitions and at completion; tier input reference diagnostics only. Never select Tier 2 policies using Tier 1 ground truth.
scope_note: CHORD-informed training budget and curriculum; not a reproduction of its PPO or FlashSAC learner. A completed budget does not imply convergence or success.
